description: This Java class `SaxParserFactory` provides factory methods to create configured instances of `SAXParser`. It also contains a `main` method demonstrating how to obtain a parser and parse an XML file named `/ecu_defs.xml`. The class ensures a singleton-like pattern by having a private constructor that throws an exception to prevent instantiation.

classes.name: SaxParserFactory
classes.description: A utility class providing static methods to create and configure `SAXParser` instances, with a demonstration `main` method.

methods.name: getSaxParser
methods.description: Creates and configures a new `SAXParser` instance with specific settings: namespace awareness disabled, validation enabled, and XInclude disabled.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Demonstrates the usage of `getSaxParser()` by creating a parser and parsing the `/ecu_defs.xml` file, printing the file size and validation status.
